description:
A new sales representative, Sarah Johnson, has just joined the company. Create her user account in Odoo and configure it for CRM access.

Perform the following steps:

1. Navigate to Settings > Users & Companies > Users
2. Create a new user with these details:
   - Name: Sarah Johnson
   - Email Address: sarah.johnson@yourcompany.example.com
3. In the Application Accesses section, set the 'Sales' access level to 'User: Own Documents Only' (this is the basic salesperson level, NOT Administrator/Manager)
4. Save the user record
5. Navigate to CRM > Configuration > Sales Teams
6. Open the 'Direct Sales' team
7. In the Members tab, add Sarah Johnson as a team member
8. Save the team record

When complete, Sarah Johnson should exist as an active user with specific CRM salesperson access rights and be listed as a member of the 'Direct Sales' sales team.
